sql.inventory_missing_identity: SELECT count(*) FROM t_inventario WHERE id_sucursal IS NULL OR id_variante IS NULL
sql.inventory_missing_quantities: SELECT count(*) FROM t_inventario WHERE stock_actual IS NULL OR stock_reservado IS NULL OR stock_disponible IS NULL
sql.inventory_negative_or_overreserved: SELECT count(*) FROM t_inventario WHERE stock_actual<0 OR stock_reservado<0 OR stock_disponible<0 OR stock_reservado>stock_actual
sql.inventory_available_mismatch: SELECT count(*) FROM t_inventario WHERE stock_disponible IS DISTINCT FROM stock_actual-stock_reservado
sql.inventory_duplicate_branch_variant_group: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT id_sucursal,id_variante FROM t_inventario WHERE id_sucursal IS NOT NULL AND id_variante IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1) x
sql.inventory_nonnull_season: SELECT count(*) FROM t_inventario WHERE id_temporada IS NOT NULL
sql.inventory_cross_company: SELECT count(*) FROM t_inventario i JOIN t_sucursal s USING(id_sucursal) JOIN t_producto_talla_color v USING(id_variante) JOIN t_producto p USING(id_producto) WHERE s.id_empresa IS DISTINCT FROM p.id_empresa
sql.variant_duplicate_product_size_color_gro: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT id_producto,id_talla,id_color FROM t_producto_talla_color GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING count(*)>1) x
sql.variant_missing_identity: SELECT count(*) FROM t_producto_talla_color WHERE id_producto IS NULL OR id_talla IS NULL OR id_color IS NULL
sql.variant_cross_company_or_global_size_col: SELECT count(*) FROM t_producto_talla_color v JOIN t_producto p USING(id_producto) JOIN t_talla t USING(id_talla) JOIN t_color c USING(id_color) WHERE p.id_empresa IS DISTINCT FROM t.id_empresa OR p.id_empresa IS DISTINCT FROM c.id_empresa
sql.variant_cross_known_company_size_color: SELECT count(*) FROM t_producto_talla_color v JOIN t_producto p USING(id_producto) JOIN t_talla t USING(id_talla) JOIN t_color c USING(id_color) WHERE (p.id_empresa IS NOT NULL AND t.id_empresa IS NOT NULL AND p.id_empresa<>t.id_empresa) OR (p.id_empresa IS NOT NULL AND c.id_empresa IS NOT NULL AND p.id_empresa<>c.id_empresa)
sql.variant_duplicate_sku_per_company_groups: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT p.id_empresa,lower(trim(v.sku)) FROM t_producto_talla_color v JOIN t_producto p USING(id_producto) WHERE nullif(trim(v.sku),'') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1) x
sql.cash_session_incoherent: SELECT count(*) FROM t_caja_sesion cs JOIN t_caja c USING(id_caja) JOIN t_sucursal s ON s.id_sucursal=c.id_sucursal WHERE cs.id_sucursal IS DISTINCT FROM c.id_sucursal OR cs.id_empresa IS DISTINCT FROM c.id_empresa OR c.id_empresa IS DISTINCT FROM s.id_empresa
sql.cash_duplicate_open_session_groups: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT id_caja FROM t_caja_sesion WHERE estado='ABIERTA' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1) x
sql.cash_duplicate_code_per_company_groups: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT id_empresa,codigo_caja FROM t_caja GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1) x
sql.user_branch_cross_known_company: SELECT count(*) FROM t_usuario_sucursal us JOIN t_usuario u USING(id_usuario) JOIN t_sucursal s USING(id_sucursal) WHERE u.id_empresa IS NOT NULL AND u.id_empresa IS DISTINCT FROM s.id_empresa
sql.client_duplicate_user_groups: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT id_usuario FROM t_cliente WHERE id_usuario IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1) x

sql.users_with_multiple_roles: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT id_usuario FROM t_usuario_rol GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1) x

sql.products_category_cross_known_company: SELECT count(*) FROM t_producto p JOIN t_categoria c USING(id_categoria) WHERE p.id_empresa IS NOT NULL AND c.id_empresa IS NOT NULL AND p.id_empresa<>c.id_empresa

sql.subscriptions_overlaps: SELECT count(*) FROM t_suscripcion a JOIN t_suscripcion b ON a.id_empresa=b.id_empresa AND a.id_suscripcion<b.id_suscripcion WHERE a.estado='ACTIVA' AND b.estado='ACTIVA' AND a.inicio<b.fin AND b.inicio<a.fin

sql.client_duplicate_profile_excess: SELECT COALESCE(sum(n-1),0)::int FROM (SELECT count(*) n FROM t_cliente WHERE id_usuario IS NOT NULL GROUP BY id_usuario HAVING count(*)>1) x
sql.products_missing_company: SELECT count(*) FROM t_producto WHERE id_empresa IS NULL
sql.branches_missing_company: SELECT count(*) FROM t_sucursal WHERE id_empresa IS NULL
sql.products_multiple_main_images_groups: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT id_producto FROM t_producto_imagen WHERE es_principal IS TRUE GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1) x
sql.paid_sales_with_header_discount: SELECT count(*) FROM t_venta WHERE descuento>0 AND estado IN ('PAGADO','COMPLETADA','ENTREGADO')
sql.legacy_notification_dependent_views: SELECT count(DISTINCT v.oid) FROM pg_depend d JOIN pg_rewrite r ON r.oid=d.objid JOIN pg_class v ON v.oid=r.ev_class WHERE d.refobjid='notificacion'::regclass AND v.relkind IN ('v','m')
sql.active_subscriptions_count: SELECT count(*) FROM t_suscripcion WHERE estado='ACTIVA'
sql.missing_canonical_primary_role: SELECT count(*) FROM t_usuario WHERE id_rol IS NULL
sql.reservations_with_declared_payment: SELECT count(*) FROM t_reserva WHERE con_pago IS TRUE OR COALESCE(monto_pagado,0)>0
sql.reservations_with_declared_payment_witho: SELECT count(*) FROM t_reserva WHERE (con_pago IS TRUE OR COALESCE(monto_pagado,0)>0) AND id_venta IS NULL
sql.paid_orders_without_sale: SELECT count(*) FROM t_pedido WHERE estado_pago='PAGADO' AND id_venta IS NULL
sql.suppliers_used_in_multiple_companies_by_: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT id_proveedor FROM t_lote WHERE id_proveedor IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT id_empresa)>1) x

details.query: SELECT id_detalle_pedido,id_variante,cantidad,subtotal FROM t_detalle_pedido WHERE id_pedido=%s ORDER BY 1

receipts_explicit_order_id.query:
SELECT operation_id,status,id_usuario,id_empresa,response_json->'data'->>'id_venta'
                        FROM t_sync_operacion WHERE response_json->'data'->>'id_pedido'=%s OR response_json->>'id_pedido'=%s

audit_explicit_order_id.query:
SELECT id_bitacora,modulo,accion,entidad,id_entidad,fecha_hora,
                        datos_nuevos->>'id_venta' FROM t_bitacora
                        WHERE (entidad IN ('t_pedido','Pedido','PEDIDO') AND id_entidad=%s)
                           OR datos_nuevos->>'id_pedido'=%s ORDER BY id_bitacora

candidate_sales_same_client_tenant_total.query:
SELECT v.id_venta,v.id_sucursal,v.fecha_venta,v.total,v.estado,
                        array_agg(p.id_pago ORDER BY p.id_pago) FILTER (WHERE p.id_pago IS NOT NULL),
                        COALESCE(sum(p.monto) FILTER (WHERE p.estado='APROBADO'),0)
                        FROM t_venta v LEFT JOIN t_pago p ON p.id_venta=v.id_venta
                        WHERE v.id_cliente=%s AND v.id_empresa=%s AND v.total=%s
                        GROUP BY v.id_venta ORDER BY v.id_venta
